patch_description:
Add compact five-row layered seeds whose horizontal coordinates span nearly the full square width. The existing hexagonal seeds use a fixed short spacing and are concentrated near the square center, forcing SLSQP to make large topology-changing moves before it can exploit boundary contacts. For 26 disks, five uneven staggered rows (especially 5-5-6-5-5 and related 26-point patterns) provide a better approximation to the expected boundary-truncated triangular contact graph.

These seeds retain deterministic asymmetric perturbations, so they explore several nearby contact graphs rather than repeatedly converging to a perfectly symmetric arrangement. Replacing several weaker six-row centered seeds keeps the portfolio size and runtime essentially unchanged.
